title: Egg and Bacon Flan
subtitle: A British shortcrust tart with a creamy egg and bacon filling
excerpt: Smoked back bacon and a creamy egg custard set in a crisp shortcrust case. A classic British flan that works warm for supper or cold for a packed lunch.
sourceNotes: British baking tradition, adapted for a standard 23cm loose-bottomed flan tin.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Bake the case blind a day ahead. Add the filling and bake on the day.

content.text: Egg and bacon flan has a blind-baked shortcrust shell, a layer of crispy bacon and a set egg custard. Blind-baking keeps the base crisp so the custard does not make it soggy. Watch the oven near the end of baking as the custard should wobble very slightly in the centre when it comes out.
Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface and line the flan tin. Trim the edges. Chill in the fridge for 30 minutes.

Heat the oven to 200C. Line the pastry case with baking paper and fill with baking beans. Blind-bake for 15 minutes. Remove the beans and paper, then bake for another 5 minutes until the base is dry and pale gold.
Fry the bacon (and onion if using) in a dry pan over a medium heat for 5 minutes until cooked. Drain on kitchen paper.
Whisk the eggs and cream together in a jug. Season with black pepper. Stir in half the cheddar.
Scatter the bacon over the base of the case. Pour the custard over slowly. Scatter the remaining cheddar on top.
Lower the oven to 170C. Bake for 25 minutes until the custard is just set with a slight wobble in the centre. Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

items.symptom: The custard is bubbly and grainy.
items.cause: The oven was too hot and the custard scrambled.
items.fix: Lower the temperature to 160C and extend the baking time. The custard sets slowly and needs a gentle heat.

items.symptom: The base is soft in the centre.
items.cause: The blind-bake was not long enough to dry out the pastry.
items.fix: After removing the baking beans, bake the empty case for an extra 5 minutes until the base looks dry and feels firm.

items.symptom: The custard is not set after the stated time.
items.cause: Ovens vary in temperature, or the flan tin is very large.
items.fix: Give it 5 more minutes and check again. The centre should wobble like set jelly, not ripple like liquid.
